Simulated peaking (0.58 dB) exceeds the ideal model because the op-amp's limited GBW (≈24 MHz) raises the Sallen-Key Q. Attenuation has about 17 dB of margin, so I'll trade it for a lower Q and retune fc. A larger input pair raises GBW and lowers Vgs, which also helps the MT headroom.

{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Topology works; peaking is from finite-GBW Q enhancement and fc is 3% high. Lower C1r (Q), raise W_in (GBW, MT headroom), retune R_sk/kp for fc. Attenuation margin (~17 dB) allows lower Q.",
 "params": {"C1r": 3.2, "W_in": 14.0, "R_sk": 70e3, "kp": 1.0, "Cc": 1.0e-12},
 "bounds": {"C1r": [2.0, 4.5], "W_in": [6.0, 24.0], "R_sk": [50e3, 100e3], "kp": [0.6, 1.4]}}
